name: smwgraphics-popful-mail-snes-gadeth-ruins-knight-statues
title: Popful Mail (SNES) - Gadeth Ruins (Knight Statues)
description:
A very mystic and mysterious background seen inside the Guardess Ruins, from the Super Famicom version of Popful Mail. A good fit for ruins or castle levels, in general. This background uses around 48 tiles, which means it has some space left in the BG2 slot for more tiles. The background is also very easy to edit and reassemble to the user's liking, as well.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
